Senior Full-stack Software Engineer

Summary:
Senior Full-stack Software Engineer developing scalable architecture for automotive solutions. Collaborating across departments to enhance operational workflows and integrate systems.
Senior Full-stack Software Engineer building scalable platforms for automotive startup
Role description:
• design, develop, and maintain full stack applications and integration services
• translate architectural patterns and design decisions into high-quality code
• work closely with Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations teams to implement integrations
• partner with senior engineers and architects to evaluate third-party platforms, SaaS tools
• write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
• collaborate within agile teams to iterate quickly and improve practices
Role requirements:
• 10+ years in software engineering preferably in automotive, e-commerce, or manufacturing-adjacent environments
• hands-on background in React.js, microservices/serverless, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and AWS
• meaningful experience delivering supply chain, procurement, or e-commerce systems at OEM or Tier-1 scale
• deep familiarity with AWS services, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud-native design patterns
• strong grasp of API design, event-driven messaging, and EDI integration patterns
• familiarity with CRM and ERP platforms and the integration patterns
• demonstrated ability to operate in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments
• ability to translate technical complexity into business outcomes for non-technical stakeholders
Benefits:
• medical
• dental
• vision
• life insurance
• disability insurance
• vacation
• 401k
• equity program
• discretionary annual incentive program
Tech stack:
AWS, Cloud, ERP, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Microservices, MongoDB, Postgres, React
